claim: What makes a Blood interior read as complex is contrast within a room and vertical range within a venue, not more rooms: per interior of 20+ square bodies E3M1 holds a median 15.5 floor heights over 2.96 bodies, 10.5 ceiling heights, 14.5 wall tiles and 37 shade steps between darkest and brightest floor (our city: 7.5, 1.45 bodies, 5.5, 7.5).
evidence: python -m tools.city_profile --interiors (2026-11-17). Adding a strongroom moved none of the numbers; a blind reviewer still called it 'ONE flat box ... flat even light'.
use: For a richer interior: light and dark inside one room (lamps with pools, dark corners), then levels (gallery, cellar, raised back), then materials; and put the trade's goods in.
